name: Buenos Aires (Colombia)
description: Horizontal bicolour of red and green, the upper half divided vertically green, white and yellow.
history: Municipal flag of Buenos Aires, a municipality in the department of Cauca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: upper half green, white and yellow; lower half red
upper half divided green, white and yellow
